BiblicalUsage: Col-hozeh is an Israelite, the father of Shallun and the ancestor of Maaseiah. Nehemiah 3:15 says Shallun the son of Col-hozeh repaired the gate of the fountain, and Nehemiah 11:5 names Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, among those who dwelt in Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Col-hozeh is remembered by his sons' work: one repaired the gate of the fountain, and the other lived in the rebuilt city.
